alerts.message: HK drawdown-risk gauge crossed up through 60/100 (now 61, band elevated) — stress legs stacking; UNCALIBRATED, read as attention not a P(drawdown) forecast
alerts.message_zh: 香港回撤风险指标上穿 60/100（现 61, band elevated）— 压力因子累积；未校准，作为关注信号而非回撤概率预测
alerts.plain_zh: 回撤风险指标升入偏高区
alerts.what_en: The drawdown-risk gauge stacks HK stress legs (slowdown, VHSI, peg stress, HIBOR, breadth) into a 0-100 read. It crossed up into elevated. IMPORTANT: UNCALIBRATED (HK history is short/global) — read as attention, never a forecast.
alerts.what_zh: 回撤风险指标把香港压力因子（放缓、VHSI、联汇压力、HIBOR、宽度）叠加为 0-100 读数。它刚上穿进入偏高区。重要：未校准（香港历史短且全球化）— 作为关注信号，绝非预测。
alerts.edge_en: Context — UNCALIBRATED stress gauge; attention, not a P(drawdown).
alerts.edge_zh: 背景 — 未校准的压力指标；关注信号，而非回撤概率。

alerts.message: A/H premium narrowed to its 14th percentile (now 27%) — the H/HK discount has compressed
alerts.message_zh: AH 溢价收窄至第 14 百分位（现 27%）— H/港股折让已压缩
alerts.what_en: The A/H premium compressed — the H/HK discount to the mainland A-share has shrunk. A rotation context, not a timing signal.
alerts.what_zh: AH 溢价压缩 — 港股 H 相对 A 股的折让收窄。轮动背景，而非择时信号。
alerts.edge_en: Context — the H/HK discount compressed; rotation context.
alerts.edge_zh: 背景 — H/港股折让压缩；轮动背景。
